annotations.title: DinCat library: question pages by shelf

description: List DinCat's library of ready-made question pages, grouped by shelf: money (take-home pay, staying a dependent, year-end adjustment), visa and residence, Japanese certification exams (FP, IT Passport, Applied Information Technology Engineer), languages (Japanese, English, Chinese) and hard-to-say conversations at work. Each link opens that question in DinCat's chat; no sign-up is needed to try.

lang.description: Language of the reply and of the linked pages: ja = Japanese, zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English. Use the user's language.

shelf.description: Only this shelf: money, visa, exam, lang or awkward. Omit for all shelves.
